decisive_items: nail thickening over the pigmented band
Bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix with invaginations of the epithelium
Villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate without melanocytic proliferation or keratinocyte atypia
response.rationale: R2 is the champion because it has the most comprehensive support from the clinical examination and histopathologic examination findings, including nail thickening and characteristic spindle cell proliferation. R3 is the runner-up because it also has support from the histopathologic examination findings, but lacks the clinical examination finding of nail thickening.

rejected.why: C1 lacks specific support from the histopathologic examination findings and has a less comprehensive clinical presentation.
